works.body:
こんにちは、私のキャラクターについて温かいお言葉をありがとうございます。ぜひ2人のピクセルアートをお願いします。

Swolekatは赤いスピードパンツを履いた筋肉質な猫のVtuberです。参考画像はこちら：https://swolekat.info/references/images/swolekat%20reference%20sheet.png

Swolebaeは赤いビキニを着た猫の女の子。参考画像はこちら：https://swolekat.info/references/images/swolebae_reference_sheet_updated.png

決まったポーズや背景はありません。お任せします。

ありがとうございました！

I received your appeal and I am happy that you are interested in my chinchilla!

I'd love to receive your work for them!

As you already know they are a gambler, I'd be very happy to see how you would bring this aspect to your art, she prefers card games, but roulettes and slot machines are also her favorites! I do not mind the pose that you choose.

https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fo/kishjwpl7fchuaznckok1/AE0N8WeG_nrl7hVuiEh3CsE?rlkey=0s2rftclhoyoaszhdblwgmi55&st=07po5til&dl=0

こんにちは！

私の茶色いウサギが、あなたのスタイルでアニメ化されるのを見たいわ！

錬金術師であり、占い師でもある彼は、紫色のオーブを使います。

ポーズはお任せしたい！

また、この作品をSNSで使用したいので、よろしくお願いします！

https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fo/pf02abh9clmfsbg6azxik/ANhBWJXU2-JEu5bqU6dtrCs?rlkey=txg5jxcz5ws9smqfvjtzcenr6&st=qrudsnvm&dl=0

Hello!
I would be happy to have you draw my VTuber!

My VTuber is a cheerful but polite non-binary plant girl, with green hair, yellow eyes, a cheerful smile, and aloe vera ears on top of her head. She has hobbies of gardening and software development.

Please note that the size of her ears compared to her head is very important.

Here is my reference sheet: https://files.catbox.moe/psgnur.png

I will be happy with your decisions. The pose and details are completely up to you.
Feel free to be creative!

If you wish to see my streams for more inspiration, here is my Twitch:
https://www.twitch.tv/hexadigital

If you would like to see additional outfit references, I have some here:
https://catbox.moe/c/n24fbr

I would like to use it on social media, and for my stream.

Thank you in advance!

https://files.catbox.moe/psgnur.png
